scope: Conditional prior-sensitivity screen on existing synthetic development observations, not a new algorithm or independent replication
limitations: Upper rate bound 4, positive spectrum, exact G(0), linear hereditary operator and exact known noise remain assumed
No support beyond rate 4 or signed/nonlinear kernels are covered
All observations are reused development data; no new ultra-slow truth or external material validation
Prediction interval utility does not imply full-kernel or equilibrium identifiability
Floating-point primal/dual checks do not provide outward-rounded certificates
Relaxing a prior within established set-membership inference does not itself establish novelty
